sources.title: PDF Self-Supervised Learning - Stanford University
sources.snippet: Can self-supervised learning help? Self-supervised learning (informal definition): supervise using labels generated from the data without any manual or as weak label sources Idea: Hide or modify part of the input. Ask model to recover input or classify what changed. Self-supervised task referred to the pretext task

sources.title: Self-supervised learning - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Self-supervised learning (SSL) is a paradigm in machine learning where a model is trained on a task using the data itself to generate supervisory signals, rather than relying on externally-provided labels.

sources.title: Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) is a type of machine learning where a model is trained using data that does not have any labels or answers provided. Instead of needing people to label the data, the model finds patterns and creates its own labels from the data automatically.

sources.title: What Is Self-Supervised Learning? Examples & Applications
sources.snippet: Learn what self-supervised learning is and how it works. Explore self-learning AI, key models, and comparisons with supervised and unsupervised learning.
